caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wall with architectural and decorative elements. The wall is divided vertically into three sections by two columns that support three wide, stone arches, each outlined with light gray-blue linear blocks. Along the top edge of the wall, there is a horizontal band with a red and brown cornice, below which is a floral frieze consisting of small red flowers, green and blue leaves, and brown stems, forming a continuous horizontal pattern. Beneath the arches, the upper part of the wall is plain and light-colored, while the lower part is decorated with two bands: the upper band features a horizontal row of small, stylized red and brown flowers with green leaves, and the lower band features a repeated floral motif with larger orange-red flowers and blue-green stems and leaves on a white background. The floral panels are bordered by slim vertical strips with blue backgrounds and orange-red diamond accents at the tops and bottoms. The base of the wall is depicted as a red-tiled floor with a rectangular pattern across the bottom of the image. The overall color palette consists of light beige, red, orange, blue, gray, green, and brown tones.
title: Restoration Drawing
